title: A Bottomless Appetite
description: Yicheng, who patrols Feiyun Slope, seems to have grown so hungry that his stomach can no longer bear it...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Bottomless Appetite
mainQuestExcel.description: Yicheng, who patrols Feiyun Slope, seems to have grown so hungry that his stomach can no longer bear it...

flow.stepDescription: Look for the source of the rumbling noise

dialogs.text: Hello, do you *RUMBLE*
Ugh, my stomach is making an awful racket again. I was saying, do you need any *RUMBLE*
Uh, you were saying?
*sigh* My stomach acts up like this every time I'm hungry. Rumble this and rumble that, and it's really loud, too. I can't even hear the sound of my own voice.
Although *RUMBLE* went to Bubu Pharmacy to get myself checked, but the doctor said that I was not sick, just hungry — so there's no cure for my *GROWL*
The doctor said that I just needed to eat full meals, but I... I've always had a bigger *GRUMBLE* than most. If I were to eat my fill every time, I'd burn a hole right through my wallet.
Jiayi tells me that if my main meals don't fill me up yet, I should buy a little something to fill in the gaps in between so it doesn't affect my work.
"Fill in the gaps," he says, but I've got a long list of dishes I'd like to eat, and I'm not sure which is best for filling my stomach.
Traveler, you're experienced in the outdoor life. Surely you know what foods fill your stomach best?
Could you help me pick the most filling and delicious dish from my list?
What would you like to eat this time?
Oh, there's plenty... Let me think...

flow.stepDescription: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

dialogs.text: Oh, I've heard there's some great-tasting dishes from Mondstadt — Sweet Madame, Mondstadt Grilled Fish, Fisherman's Toast, Calla Lily Seafood Soup...
Well, just get me the one that'll best fill my stomach. Thanks for your help!
If I eat that, at least my stomach won't be crying out all day...
Have you found that filling dish yet?
I've got it.
Great, let me have a taste.
Not yet.
Alright. If you mean to get Fisherman's Toast, I know that the Wanmin Restaurant usually sells it.
Hmm, I've heard a merchant from Mondstadt say that the Good Hunter has this Calla Lily Seafood Soup. I think it could be pretty good.
Speaking of Mondstadt dishes, Grilled Fish and Sweet Madame should be quite simple to make.
*RUMBLE* ...Ah, even just saying the names of these dishes out loud is making me hungrier still...

dialogs.text: I'm craving some Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup but also some Black-Back Perch Stew... though some Mondstadt dishes also catch my fancy. A Chicken-Mushroom Skewer wouldn't go amiss, nor would a Tea Break Pancake or several...
Well, just get me the one that will best fill my stomach. Thanks for your help!
If I eat that, at least my stomach won't be crying out all day...
Have you found that filling dish yet?
I've got it.
Great, let me have a taste.
Not yet.
I've heard that Chef Mao of the Wanmin Restaurant knows how to make Black-Back Perch Stew — you can ask him.
As for Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup, I think Herbalist Gui knows the recipe. He works at Bubu Pharmacy in Yujing Terrace if you need to ask him about it.
I've heard from a merchant that the Tea Break Pancakes from Good Hunter in Mondstadt taste really good, and are very filling as well.
As for Chicken-Mushroom Skewers... Surely they can't be that hard to make?
*RUMBLE* ...Ah, even just saying the names of these dishes out loud is making me hungrier still...

Just thinking about it makes me *RUMBLE*
Please help me out and get me one of those dishes... I just need my stomach to stop *GROWL* for the day...

This smells odd. The ingredients haven't been cut properly, and this chunk here isn't even well-cooked!
Well, it doesn't seem promising, but it's got quantity, so it'll at least keep my stomach quiet.
*burp* Thank you. This is just a token of my appreciation. Please take it. *burp*
This taste, this smell, it's wonderful!
The quantity is sufficient, as well. I just can't get enough! My stomach isn't grumbling anymore, either! *burp*
It's just that now that I'm full, I can't help burping. *burp*
Thank you so much. Please take this as a token of my appreciation. *burp*
This taste is... really odd. Feels like it was left overnight. Not at all like I was told it would taste.
The texture is bad, almost like chewing on sand... The quantity is small as well. Why, I finished it in one or two bites.
*sigh* This won't be enough for sure. Guess I'll have to go look for something else to chew on...
Still, thank you, friend. Please take this as thanks.
This dish is well-made indeed. A lot of effort must have gone into it, and it does taste great.
Still... there's a bit too little of it. Can't fill my stomach like this.
It was still nice to eat such a delicious *RUMBLE* though...
Thank you. Please accept these.
